digest.component_or_area: LLM framework usage logging and cost summarization
propositions: usage_log.record() must capture model, provider, and UTC ISO timestamp in addition to the four token fields to enable accurate cost lookup
summarize() must convert stored JSONL row dicts to genai_prices input format, pricing each row by its own model/provider/timestamp without reliance on live pydantic-ai objects
Pricing failures (missing model, malformed rows, or unexpected exceptions) must never crash summarize; unknown rows are marked unpriced and the summary notes the exclusion count
When genai-prices is unavailable, summarize must degrade gracefully to print token totals with cost marked 'unavailable (install rebar[pricing])' and exit cleanly
Existing rows in the old format (without model, provider, or timestamp fields) must still summarize without error
